Name: Malthouse
Notes: THE ORDER COLUMN IS THE MAP. Section 1 is the first building you walk to. It also decides what may feed what: a section can only be given something an EARLIER section makes, or something raw - otherwise the chain cannot be started and tools/brewery_check.gd says so.

Name: Mill
Notes: The hammer is a tool, so it is needed but not spent. See the Kept column of BreweryResources.csv.

Name: Boiling & Hopping
Notes: Four things at once, which is why this is the section that runs you out of something. The mini-game you described - the circles that must all turn the same way round - goes on top of this row later and changes nothing underneath it.

Name: Cooling & Fermenting
Notes: WAIT MIN and WAIT MAX are the lagering. The barrel is not yours the moment you press the button - it sits in the cellar for one to three turns, and a turn is a fixture. Set both to 0 and it is instant.

Name: Bottling & Filling
Notes: HOW MANY is why this section exists: one barrel becomes six bottles. That number is the whole economy of the Pub - raise it and drinks are cheap, lower it and every bottle is a decision.
